# Badge

Small non-interactive numerical value or status descriptor for UI elements.
See [Badge guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/badge/design/)

To display a status with a text use the <LinkTo kind="Components/Chip" story="basic">Chip</LinkTo> component.
